name: chart_e2e_20260907

dimensions.name: country
dimensions.expression: CASE WHEN order_id IN (1,2,3) THEN 'KR' WHEN order_id=4 THEN 'PREVIOUS' WHEN order_id=5 THEN 'US' WHEN order_id=6 THEN 'JP' ELSE 'EXCLUDED' END

dimensions.name: city
dimensions.expression: CASE WHEN order_id IN (1,2) THEN 'Seoul' WHEN order_id=3 THEN 'Busan' WHEN order_id=5 THEN 'New York' ELSE 'Tokyo' END

measures.name: sales
measures.expression: CASE order_id WHEN 1 THEN 20000.00 WHEN 2 THEN 24000.00 WHEN 3 THEN 30520.00 WHEN 4 THEN 65000.00 WHEN 5 THEN 100000.00 WHEN 6 THEN 30000.00 ELSE 0.00 END

description: Chart E2E dedicated read-only projection over existing Northstar orders 1..6; no warehouse mutation
